summary: Avoid per-member identity reads for quiet attention scans

schema.detail: No claim or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Parked-runtime attention first checks whether an agent has a crash-loop decision before resolving its declaration and identity. Unstarted-seat attention first excludes seats with any runtime observation. Quiet rosters no longer pay identity reads for every agent. Actual attention candidates retain their full declaration and lifecycle admission fences.
